sentences.en: Miss Scarlett was killed with a candlestick in the ballroom.
sentences.zh: 斯卡尔特小姐是在舞厅被烛台杀死的。

sentences.en: The princess held a masquerade ball in the grand ballroom.
sentences.zh: 公主在宏伟的舞厅举办了一场化装舞会。

sentences.en: The king held a masquerade ball in the grand ballroom.
sentences.zh: 国王在宏伟的舞厅举办了一场化装舞会。
